name: John Meyers Sr.
description: JD's father. Clarkson electrical engineering graduate (1983). Long career across teaching, sales, and small business; owner-operator of Taxi Zero in Potsdam since 2014. Also runs Adirondack Quality Apartments and Airbnb rentals.
bio: BS and MS from Clarkson. Career arc: math teaching, fire alarm sales, then small business — owns Taxi Zero (Potsdam taxi service), Adirondack Quality Apartments, and Airbnb short-term rentals. Co-took the FAA Part 107 exam with JD in April 2018 — both passed.
public_footprint:
Same person as John Meyers of Taxi Zero: the business's site identifies its TikTok channel as @john_meyers_sr, where he posts about starting your own taxi business and travel. Taxi Zero has operated in Potsdam, Canton, Ogdensburg, and Massena since 2014.
Sources: https://txizero.com/taxi/taxi-zero-posts-on-tiktok/; https://txizero.com/category/taxi/service/potsdam-ny/page/4/
